subject: op-spd
title: OP.SPD.------EXP.INFO.B.
description: Diagram in WI-12. (C)OP-SPD (option spread) is crossed with EXP-INFO-B (expansion information basis). 'Option spread' is one of Braxton's central diagnostic terms in the WI section — the differential range of choices available to white vs. non-white creative people in this cycle. The diagram poses what option-spread crossed with expansion-information-basis actually shapes. OP-SPD → EXP-INFO-B (the crossing). OP-SPD also branches to A-PR (all-purpose) → SPT-DY (spiritual dynamics), to TRS (transition) → POL-DYM (political dynamics), and to INTR (interpretation). INTR branches to BIA (bi-aitional) → EXT-FT (extended functionalism) and to AFL-DT (affinity dictates) → SOC-RT-DY (social reality dynamics).
